headline: London Zoo hatches 15 tiny frogs from Ghana species
meta_description: London Zoo successfully hatches 15 frogs from a species threatened by mining in Ghana, marking a conservation win for an endangered amphibian.
summary_short: London Zoo has hatched 15 frogs from a species facing extinction due to mining operations in Ghana—a rare breeding success for conservation efforts.
body:
London Zoo has successfully hatched 15 tiny frogs from a species threatened by mining in Ghana. The breeding represents a meaningful step forward in protecting an amphibian population under severe pressure from industrial activity.

The hatching highlights how zoos can play a crucial role in species preservation when wild habitats face destruction. By maintaining breeding populations in controlled environments, institutions like London Zoo create a safety net for species pushed toward the brink by human activity.
